title: Dynamic Form Preview
description: Create a form that live‑previews user input using two‑way binding.
problemStatement:
Build a simple profile editor with live preview.

**Requirements:**
1. In `AppComponent`, create properties: `fullName`, `email`, `bio`.
2. In the template, add three input fields bound with `[(ngModel)]`.
3. Below the inputs, display a “Profile Card” that shows the values dynamically as the user types.
4. Ensure `FormsModule` is imported.
5. Style the card with some CSS (scoped) so it looks like a card.
6. Verify that any change in inputs instantly updates the card.
hints: The preview can just be a `<div class="card">` with interpolation.
expectedOutput: Typing in the name field immediately shows the name in the card. Same for email and bio.
